description: WordCraft: an open-source, clean-room word processor in pure Rust

latest_release.name: WordCraft v0.16.0
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Text boxes: a press inside one goes to its text, not to a picture under it by @arcanii in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/4240
* Flag document fonts that aren't installed by @alehel in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/4770
* DOCX: nil shading paints no fill, border theme colours win (part of #1991) by @VoiceLessQ in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/4705
* Format readers: one border-type table for .doc, one HYPERLINK parser for DOCX, RTF and .doc by @VoiceLessQ in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/4222
* AutoFormat: a tracked heading or border line replaces another author's formatting change by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/4231
* Layout: 行頭禁則 lists small kana and the prolonged sound mark (JIS X 4051 §4), with the emergency-break gap documented by @midasdf in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/2558
* Arabic interface: mirror the remaining label/field dialogs by @tlomts-dev in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/5449
* Read Mode: ink and drag previews follow the Page color, which is kept between entries by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/4228
* #2726: AccessKit focus guard — every tree update carries its focused node by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/2742
* Audit fixes for 12 issues: import limits, escaping, link schemes, table depth by @VoiceLessQ in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/3862
* Walk Print Markup comment objects once (#3614) by @OPUZZLES in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/4744
* Undo: steps share the style sheet and list definitions (1.2 GB → 21 MB at the limit) by @arcanii in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/2694
* #641: print N-up sheets and folded booklets by @LQRD in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/3916
* fix(print): report noPrinters when CUPS discovery finds no destinations by @asmodeus-oos in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1826
* Walk Print Markup balloon anchors once (#3614) by @OPUZZLES in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/4785
* Show fresh SEQ, STYLEREF and REF results in PDF export and printing by @pakiat in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/5162
* File › Print: Return prints, as Word's default Print button does by @jpc7k1 in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/4651
* ODT: full open, edit and save support, lossless on save without edits (gap 19) by @alehel in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/5559
* Fix #5559 follow-ups: generated list prefix, hidden-text objects, turned clipped lines, kept-markup checks by @FredApps in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/5593
* Desktop: a window restored onto no monitor opens on screen by @fluorine in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/4742
* #3955: Format Shape's Angle field leaves an angle above 359.9° alone by @rabis7575 in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/3959
* Picture brightness, contrast and transparency from DOCX: VML washout, a:lum, a:alphaModFix (#1711, #1766) by @mmazzieri in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1961
* Align the caret on the empty line after a trailing line break by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/4293
* Dialogs are modal, as in Word (#3859) by @RatkoR in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/4076
* Insert Date & Time and date fields use local time, not UTC (#1707) by @dkhlapov in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1782
* ODT: remove the display settings; one choice for each open case (gap 19) by @alehel in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/5609
* Pass the Linux signing key to the release workflow by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/5614
* Drop Cap follow-ups: whole selection, script fonts, margin gap, menu keeps options (#2601) by @dkhlapov in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/4077
* Tests: the balloon anchor test counts work steps instead of timing by @dotCooCoo

DOCX: legacy form fields (FORMCHECKBOX/FORMTEXT) are not drawn and lose ffData on save; rows with gridBefore are mispositioned and lose it on save
Report: a real-world corpus run of 400 Word files against 0.7.0 — open, text, save round trip, checked in Word 365
[BUG] Pictures from Clipboard provides an Error
Linux (GNOME Wayland): window title bar doesn't match the desktop theme

detail.readme_excerpt:
WordCraft

Writing and document design; an open-source, modern word processor, built in pure Rust.

A fast, open-source word processor with a familiar workflow: the ribbon, styles, tables, track changes, references and mail merge. It reads and writes .docx, runs natively on macOS, Windows, Linux and BSD, and in the browser via WebAssembly.
By the ArtCraft team.


WordCraft on getartcraft.com · ArtCraft · All Crafting Apps



The Open Studio Handbook, WordCraft's built-in sample: the ribbon, live Styles gallery, rulers and the Navigation pane.
